changes.comment: The relay knows which folder was carved out of which vault, so a key for one of your own devices reaches the folders you share later without you pasting anything. A folder's own key still reaches only that folder — never the vault it came from, and never a folder beside it.
An existing relay upgrades its own database the first time it starts on this version, in place. Every key handed out before it keeps working exactly as it did, as a key to its one folder.

Once the relay has recorded which vault a folder came from, it refuses to re-file that folder under a different vault — so nobody holding the relay's operator password can quietly attach someone else's folder to their own vault. Re-sharing the same folder from the same vault is unaffected.
